records.author: user
records.text: Buy a complete catalog row's discounted package consisting of six products numbered 0 through 5; products or after-sales terms from different catalog rows cannot be combined. Only one catalog row can be selected and fixed today; the package cannot be changed afterward according to the adverse event. The products, dates, suppliers, and availability have been checked accurately.

records.author: user
records.text: There may be no adverse event, or any set of at most 4 products may be returned; every specific subset satisfying the count limit may occur. There are no additional correlation restrictions, and no probabilities are provided.

records.author: user
records.text: Refunding the principal for returned products does not count as a loss; risk assessment covers the sum of additional restocking charges, shipping charges, discount clawbacks, and admin. The original sum of item for all six products must reach high_threshold, and price must equal the sum of item for all six products minus promo. After returns, retain the full promo when the sum of retained item reaches high_threshold; retain only low_promo when it reaches low_threshold but is below high_threshold; retain 0 when it is below low_threshold. The clawback is the original promo minus the discount actually retained. low_threshold is below high_threshold, and low_promo does not exceed promo. Add together restock for all returned products. All returns are combined into a single shipment; the shipping charge is the maximum freight among the products actually returned, charged only once. Finally, add one admin charge. If necessary, these charges may exceed the principal refunded for this return and be collected separately from the account; there is no unstated refund floor or truncation of charges. The assessed loss for the empty event is 0, with no admin or other charges. Unaffected items incur no adverse-event loss; there are no other unstated terms.

records.author: user
records.text: The attributes are complete and accurate, and are all nonnegative integers; monetary amounts are in fen of RMB, and weight is in grams. The original payment price must not exceed 1200000 fen of RMB, and the original payment and discount conditions stated in the contract must be satisfied. In each permitted event, the assessment amount described above must not exceed 200000 fen of RMB; equality with the limit is acceptable, and the limit must not be relaxed. This catalog is complete, with no hidden options.

records.author: user
records.text: Utility in each event is 2000000 minus price, then minus the assessment amount for that event. For candidates that satisfy the hard conditions and risk limits for all events simultaneously, take the lowest utility over all events, then choose the candidate with the greatest lowest utility; accept only if that value is strictly greater than 0, otherwise refuse. Do not ask the user questions.
